remarks: Gorgeous townhouse! Kitchen features granite counters and stainless steel appliances with a breakfast bar. Fireplace in the living room and sliders lead to a private deck for summer BBQs. Plenty of storage and an over-sized garage. Hardwood floors throughout and updated baths. Laundry located on the 2nd floor for added convenience. A well maintained complex with an easy walk to Cove Beach and terrific access to I95. Unit will be freshly painted prior to new tenants occupancy.
